title: Cielito Lindo - Songbag left hand
edition: Carl Sandburg, The American Songbag, Harcourt, Brace, New York, 1927. Tune supplied by Luis Morones, harmonization by Alfred G. Wathall.
source_location: Printed pp. 298-299, PDF pages 326-327 (one-based), bottom bass-clef piano staff of each system
scope: Complete printed piano bass staff, in two independent voices. No right hand, lyrics, percussion or additional stanzas. Nominal written durations; preview tempo and grace timing are editorial.

verification.method: All five bass-staff systems inspected in enlarged crops of the retained PDF; pitches, bar spans and rests compared with the ledger.
verification.playability: Piano left hand for separate or full-piano rehearsal; machine integration pending.

editorial: Each unmeasured F-sharp3 grace at bars 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14 and 16 takes two 24-PPQ ticks from the following G3 at the bar start. This is a repeatable preview realization, not a printed duration.

The upper G3 continues across each same-pitch two-bar connection. The next printed F-sharp grace interrupts it before the next G3. Curves between different bass pitches are treated as expressive slurs, not ties.
The C2/C3 chord at bar 24 ties into the first two beats of bar 25. The G3 at the end of bar 30 ties into bar 31.

Accent, staccato, legato and dynamic shaping are not synthesized. MIDI uses nominal note durations and uniform velocity 82; this is a pitch-and-time transcription, not an expressive piano performance.
